observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor public performance on a paved street or square in front of buildings and trees, with seated spectators visible in the background.
observation.dancers: Group of 10-12 mixed adult dancers (men and women).
observation.formation_and_space: Circular formation holding hands, moving in a circle, occasionally transitioning into paired turning or arched formations.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight bounce in knees and rhythmic weight shifts.
observation.footwork: Stepping in a walking or running pattern travelling around the circle, synchronized with the musical beat; exact weight transfer details cannot be seen.
observation.arms_and_hands: Hands joined in a circle, arms swinging or held at shoulder height; raising hands to form arches; pairs holding hands for turning figures.
observation.hips_and_torso: Natural movement with body sway accompanying the steps, upright posture maintained.
observation.partnering: Circular group hold; brief paired hand-holds and closed turns between partners.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low-level travel, occasional turning figures in pairs, and bowing at the end.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional folk costumes worn by all dancers: white shirts, trousers with suspenders or vests for men; blouses, vests, patterned skirts, and aprons for women.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork nuances, precise weight distribution, and subtle technical execution are obscured by video resolution and distance.

signature_moments.what: Dancers join hands in a circle and step sideways or travel around the ring to live accordion and fiddle music.
Dancers raise joined hands overhead to form an arch while continuing to circle.
Dancers pair up to spin in closed dance holds within the circle.
